description.value: Shishlik Grill House is a Persian kebab restaurant on North Vancouver's busy Lonsdale Avenue, serving an extensive menu of authentic Iranian grilled meats — from house-made Loghmeh to premium Shishlik lamb racks — alongside traditional stews like Ghormeh Sabzi and Fesenjan. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations (the second in Coquitlam) and uses a Square-powered platform for online pickup and delivery ordering. Cyclists riding the Lonsdale corridor will find filling rice-and-kebab platters and a broad menu well suited to a mid-tour meal.

address.value: 1629 Lonsdale Avenue, North Vancouver, BC V7M 2J5
